routine.note: Derived, not measured. Re-derive with deriveGpDemand() if capacity or rho change.

complex.note: ⚠️ Carries the median-improves-tail-worsens finding, and rests on an assumed share. Albert: this is the most load-bearing unsourced number in the model.

targetUtilisation.note: ⚠️ No direct utilisation estimate for a matched English practice was found. Expect this at the top of the tornado — waiting time is convex in it, so its range drives the width of the three worlds more than anything else in the model.

complex.note: NHS-SIM has only acuity 2 and 3, so "complex" has no ground truth at all.

urgent.note: A&E acuity-2 share was 0.2%, but that is emergency mix, not GP mix.

dischargeLettersPerDay.citation: snapshot 2026-09-21T12:02Z · world team-4551d2471320 · 57 discharge summaries over ~9 sim-days
dischargeLettersPerDay.note: A hospital-driven stream, independent of GP demand.

edPerDay.note: Parked for the ED node (step 5). Must NOT be fed to the GP node — doing so was what produced the 691-day baseline wait.

communitySlotsPerDay.note: The binding constraint. Small base means the capacity multiplier bites hard.

staffedSpaces.citation: snapshot 2026-09-21T12:02Z · world team-4551d2471320 · view.staffing (4 doctors, 4 nurses)

gpAdminShare.note: Derived from reported GP admin and total workload in 2005 and 2019. This is a historical endpoint range, not a confidence interval.

communityVisit.note: Constant in the ground truth, and matches the handbook figure exactly.

bloodResultTurnaround.note: Not yet observed live — no completed result transitions in this world.

pharmacyApproval.note: Not measurable: exactly one approved prescription exists in the world.

complex.note: A double appointment. Assumed — NHS-SIM has no complex class to measure. Drives the tail finding, so its range feeds straight into the three worlds.

letterReviewedToFiled.note: The manual-chasing attrition Chapter 3 is about. 84% of letters never get filed.

communityRejection.note: Community refuses at capacity (409), but no baseline referral flow exists to measure.

monitoringIntensity.citation: snapshot 2026-09-21T12:02Z · world team-4551d2471320 · baseline = no change
monitoringIntensity.note: Base is measurable; the EFFECT of monitoring on admission is not in the sim. Effect size must come from the corpus.

hospitalToCommunityShare.note: ⚠️ NOT GROUNDED. The only 7 community visits in the world were created by team14. There is no baseline referral flow to measure.

weekdayDischargeShare.note: ⚠️ The weekend is ours: NHS-SIM has no weekday logic. Acts on letter turnaround only — admin is shut at weekends, so a Saturday discharge waits for Monday.

telephoneServiceMultiplier.note: A telephone consultation is shorter than a face-to-face one, but NHS-SIM books both in the same 15-minute slot, so it cannot tell us by how much. TODO(albert): source it — without a real number the telephone lever is decorative.

telephoneBaselineShare.citation: snapshot 2026-09-21T12:02Z · world team-4551d2471320 · 2 of 6 sessions have data.mode = 'telephone'
telephoneBaselineShare.note: Not a lever. The mix already inside the measured 15-minute slot, so the engine can normalise and avoid discounting a slot length that is already an average.

monitoringEscalationReduction.note: Fraction of urgent/complex demand that monitoring turns into routine demand, per unit of intensity. The range starts at ZERO deliberately: "remote monitoring changes nothing" has to stay inside the pessimistic world, or the model assumes the answer.

inducedDemand.note: Declared, not measured. NHS-SIM generates 142 arrivals/day regardless of what we do, so induced demand cannot occur in the ground truth. Report the breakeven instead.

gaming.note: Declared. No coding or reclassification exists in the sim to game.

winterDemandMultiplier.note: TODO(albert): source winter demand uplift in primary care.

winterUrgentMultiplier.note: NHS-SIM's winter-pressure scenario raises urgent arrivals; magnitude is ours.

shortageCommunityMultiplier.note: NHS-SIM's staff-shortage scenario reduces home-visit slots.
